s0.title: Welcome to AutoToDo
s0.subtitle: Meeting notes become action items automatically.
s0.desc: AutoToDo reads your meeting transcripts and uses AI to automatically extract all tasks, owners and deadlines — directly as a structured action list (LOP).

s1.title: Step 1 – Create a project
s1.subtitle: One project per client or team.
s1.desc: Click "New project" on the dashboard. Enter a name and an optional description. All transcripts and action items are assigned to the project.

s2.title: Step 2 – Upload transcript
s2.subtitle: Copy & paste or file upload.
s2.desc: Open a project and click "↑ Upload transcript". You can paste text directly or upload a .txt or .rtf file. AI processing starts automatically.

s3.title: Step 3 – AI extracts tasks
s3.subtitle: Fully automatic – in seconds.
s3.desc: The AI (Anthropic, OpenAI or Azure) analyses the transcript and creates action items with title, owner, due date, priority and status. Uncertain items are flagged for review.

s4.title: Step 4 – Edit the action list
s4.subtitle: Filter, edit, set status.
s4.desc: In the action list you can filter by status, priority and owner. Click a title to edit all details in a dialog. Status changes can be made directly in the row.

s5.title: Step 5 – Add items manually
s5.subtitle: Add tasks independently of a transcript.
s5.desc: Click "+ Add item manually" at the top of the project page. A form opens where you can enter title, owner, due date and priority.

s6.title: Step 6 – Export & share
s6.subtitle: XLSX export with workspace branding.
s6.desc: Use "↓ XLSX" to export the action list as an Excel file with workspace colour and metadata. Use "+ Invite member" to add colleagues to the project.
